title: Pipe Specification Contradiction: 500mm Installed vs 750mm Billed

document_a.snippet: Stormwater Line SW-02: Installed 500mm ID Class 4 RCP pipe at 0.5% slope.

document_b.snippet: Supply and installation of 750mm ID heavy-duty reinforced stormwater line SW-02.

expected_output.conflict_summary: As-built drawing DR-C-701 documents installation of 500mm diameter pipe, but change order CO-2026-CV-003 bills for 750mm diameter pipe.

sources.snippet: Supply and installation of 750mm ID heavy-duty

expected_output.recommended_action: Conduct CCTV pipe inspection to confirm physical installed bore diameter.
